usedFor: Storydoc builds interactive business documents, and “Create Personalized Story Version” tailors one to a recipient.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create Personalized Story Version” in Storydoc
bestTemplate.why: The action creates a personalized version using the recipient and branding you pass in.

watchOut: “Generate a new story from a prompt” turns a prompt into a presentation, so review it before sharing.
